department: UCD School of Biology and Environmental Science

deadline.value: Registration starts in September, January or May; the School asks for applications 4-5 months before registration, with no closing date.
deadline.quote: Applications should be made at least 4-5 months prior to the Registration deadline.

gre_subject.value: There is no Biology GRE Subject test, and the page does not mention GRE.

supervisor.value: A member of staff must agree to supervise before the application is submitted.
supervisor.quote: Once a member of our academic staff has agreed to supervise you, they will need to submit the application form to the Graduate Administrator.

funding.value: The School's Research Demonstratorships pay a scholarship, but the School says it is not offering them for 2025/26.
funding.quote: Research demonstrators are paid a scholarship of €25,000 per annum for a total period of four years

entry_route.value: A first degree of at least an upper second class, and/or a master's degree, is normally needed.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for research degree should normally possess a first degree of at least an upper second class honours primary degree or the equivalent and/or Master's degree or its equivalent.

notes: Environment is listed in also_fields because the School's PhD and MSc (Research) page describes the School's disciplines as including environmental science. Applicants must contact a supervisor first; the School's application page is the only source for this statement.
